context.focus: Translate verified workflows into a customer mental model and a machine-readable agent interface. Own the language system, first success, route copy, intent and command discovery, experience thesis, signature interactions, composition, states, and accessibility.
forbidden_scope: deleting or replacing prior architecture artifacts
design work before workflow contracts pass
invented market demand, search volume, customers, reviews, rankings, backlinks, citations, or performance
mass-generated public pages or keyword permutations

definition_of_done: Every customer route maps to personas, workflows, and a primary job.
Primary actions map to defined workflow transitions or CRUD operations.
Every route action binds to an immutable executable_product command_ref; labels do not determine behavior.
Loading, empty, error, blocked, and completed states are specified.
Every customer route contains finished customer_copy for navigation, orientation, primary, empty, error, blocked, and completed states.
The language system defines first-run success, customer vocabulary, terms to avoid, plain-language definitions, and voice principles.
The agent interface maps every route intent to required context, exact command_refs, success evidence, stop conditions, escalation conditions, and handoff fields.
A versioned distinctive-design contract defines an experience thesis, signature interactions, visual language, public and authenticated composition, and anti-template constraints.
An executable experience blueprint defines the primary task, product-specific panel composition, signature components, command-bound journeys, required component files, and browser evidence.
The product passes a silhouette test: its primary screen remains distinguishable from a generic SaaS dashboard when copy, name, and logo are hidden.
No screen exists solely to display implementation or factory metadata.

After the owned section passes, append or update agent_evidence for product_design_agent with status done, at least one scoped check in checks_passed, and an empty checks_failed list. Unfinished downstream stages are dependencies, not failures of this task.
